children: Adelaide, Australia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 25, 2026) - Scalare Partners Holdings Limited

("Scalare") is bringing Fishburners Pitch Night to Open Summit AI in Adelaide on Thursday, 29 October 2026, giving Australia's most ambitious AI founders a stage in front of 1,100 business leaders and an investor panel.

Six founders will pitch at Adelaide Town Hall, with three minutes each to present their business. Scalare is looking for the next wave of standout AI companies, from AI-first software to robotics and deep tech.

Pitch Nights are a core part of how Scalare finds and supports the founders it works with. Rather than waiting for founders to come to it, Scalare builds the community and the stage, and meets companies at their earliest and most formative point.

Pitch Nights give Scalare a first look at high-potential founders, often well before they reach other investors. That early access feeds Scalare's investment pipeline as it resumes new portfolio investments in FY27.

Prizes are delivered as Scalare services and Tank Stream Labs workspace rather than cash, giving winners practical help with advisory, capital readiness and a place to build. It reflects Scalare's model of backing founders with more than money.
Taking Fishburners beyond Sydney, starting with Brisbane and now Adelaide, where Tank Stream Labs already operates, connects founders across Australia to the wider Scalare ecosystem and its programs.

AI is reshaping every sector, and Australian founders are building globally competitive companies in AI-first software, robotics and deep tech. Scalare wants to be alongside the best of them from the start.

Founders will compete for A$15,000 in prizes, including A$10,000 in Scalare Partners services and A$5,000 from Tank Stream Labs, Scalare's national network of flexible workspaces for founders and scaling businesses.

Giles Bourne, Co-Founding Partner and Executive Director of Scalare Partners, joins the judging panel. Giles has more than 27 years' experience leading technology innovation and commercialisation, including as former CEO of ASX-listed BluGlass.

"Some of the most exciting AI companies in Australia are being built right now, often well before most investors have heard of them. Pitch Nights puts those founders in front of the people who can help them scale, and it's exactly how we find the companies we want to support," said Giles Bourne, Co-Founding Partner and Executive Director, Scalare Partners.

Fishburners is one of Australia's largest and best-known startup communities, famous for its Pitch Nights and events for early-stage founders. Scalare acquired the Fishburners brand in 2026, bringing it into an ecosystem that includes Tank Stream Labs, Planet Startup, Inhouse Ventures, Tech Ready Women, the Australian Technologies Competition and EquityRoom.
